# Squares of identifications: compatibility import

The implementation moved to Section02 to support the early naturality
calculus. This path reexports the same definitions and proof bodies.

```agda
{-# OPTIONS --without-K #-}
module SCT.VolumeI.Chapter01.Section03.Identifications.IdentificationSquares where
open import SCT.VolumeI.Chapter01.Section02.IdentificationSquares public
```
